args.description: Quiet distant ruined marine court, frontal side-view stage background. Tall layered broken sea-green arches, dark blue-green depth, recognizable closed tide gate centered, sparse ivory shell inlays, warm muted coral only at outer edges. No floor, no characters, no text. Low contrast broad pixel clusters. Seamless dark edges so extension is quiet. Match Dungeon Matcher crisp native pixel-art: no anti-aliasing, gradients, blur or noisy individual speckles. Top-left light.
